name: vitta-deal-evaluator
description: Compares discovered candidates against the user’s constraints and proposes the best purchase. A proposal is not authorization — Vitta’s gate decides whether it may be spent.

skills.name: Evaluate deals
skills.description: Select the cheapest eligible candidate (size, stock, merchant and price ceiling respected) and explain why.
examples: Pick the cheapest eligible 2kg atta under ₹300
